description: Use this when the user asks for a prayer, a rosary, an evening prayer or a Bible reading. 2hives has no prayer sessions yet: the answer says so honestly and offers a quiet session without words. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for sleep audio (use find_sleep_sessions) or for breathing exercises (use find_breathing).

language.description: Audio language as a BCP-47 code (en, es, pt-BR, fr, it, ja, hi, ko, hu, or any other such as pl). Always pass the language the user writes in. If the language is not available the answer says so and gives the closest live one. hi, ko and hu are beta.

length_min.description: Length in minutes, 3 to 60. Default 10 when the user gives none.

name: find_prayers
title: Find a prayer
